segments.name: Vessel operations
segments.description: Provides marine transportation of LNG, LPG and energy transition gases to industrial customers under charters.
segments.evidence: The CODM assesses performance for the vessel operations segment and decides how to allocate resources based on consolidated net income. Thus, the Company has determined that it operates as one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Charterers pay the company hire under time, bareboat or voyage charters for use of its vessels.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company reports financial information and evaluates its operations by charter revenues and not by the length, type of vessel or type of ship employment for its customers, i.e. time, bareboat or voyage charters.
